newsitem.title: UK: Boots shares rise on cash payout hopes.
newsitem.headline: Boots shares rise on cash payout hopes.

text.p: Shares in Boots Co Plc climbed 15p to 728 following a newspaper article saying the chemist retail chain is working on a plan to return about 400 million stg in cash to shareholders.
The Sunday Times said the plan is likely to be disclosed next month when Boots announces its full-year results.

Last year, Boots spent 300 million stg on a share buy-back. The Sunday Times said the company was now looking for other ways to return cash to shareholders as tax changes have made share buy-backs unattractive.
The newspaper said Boots might announce a one-off special dividend or issue a new class of new shares, which could be redeemed for cash.
No-one at Boots was immediately available to comment.
